summary: Frontend-only testing of editor authoring changes (Insert button, slash-inserted Columns/Accordion MDX, sonner toasts, unsaved-changes badge). All 9 scenarios from the review request passed on https://mdx-editor-staging.preview.emergentagent.com/admin/editor/d901b4ab-a271-4aff-b63a-bf92d73b9bb0/c83eef51-7f8c-40e6-b9d3-823edbfbb798.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx is ~1320 lines; per code review guideline (>700 lines), consider splitting the header/toolbar, sidebar nav, and link-modal into separate components for maintainability.

handleSave useMemo/useCallback dependency list omits 'title', 'content', 'icon' being referenced via closures - deps list includes them via variables but double-check to avoid stale closures (currently works because they are listed). Non-blocking.
The 'Add Image' toolbar button lacks parity with the Insert menu's image action - both should ideally route through the same handler; minor UX consistency note.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing project/doc IDs provided in the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is bypassed via DISABLE_AUTH=true - navigate directly to /admin/editor/{projectId}/{docId}. Editor takes ~2-3s to load past the spinner. Sonner toasts appear bottom-right with attribute data-sonner-toast; the Insert popover MDX inserts write into the textarea via React state so read value via el.value. Note: the test flow ends with title set back to 'Test Doc' and multiple Accordion/Columns blocks inserted then saved - the test document has been modified in the DB.
